title: Commerce storefront website
summary: A store whose website converts browsing into buying: catalogue browsing, product decisions in a detail page, cart management, and a trustworthy checkout.
defaults: Lead every view with the primary buy action
Attach price and stock next to the add-to-cart control
Show the cart as a dedicated view, not only a counter
End checkout in a clear order confirmation
risks: Flat catalogue with no product detail view
Cart reduced to a counter with no editable view
verification: Browse catalogue and open a product detail view
Add to cart, edit quantities, and view the cart
Complete checkout and see an order confirmation
site_goals: Sell product by converting browsing into checkout
Reduce purchase friction with clear price, stock, and shipping information
Build first-time buyer trust with product visuals and reviews
